current_text.html: God hath appointed a day, wherein he will judge the world, in righteousness, by Jesus Christ, to whom all power and judgment is given of the Father. In which day, not only the apostate angels shall be judged, but likewise all persons that have lived upon earth shall appear before the tribunal of Christ, to give an account of their thoughts, words, and deeds; and to receive according to what they have done in the body, whether good or evil.

metadata.synopsis: TEs Bulkeley and Gillikin complained that Highlands Presbytery refused to record their dissent against Presbytery's act of recording a letter from the Arden Presbyterian Session affirming the Martins' Christian character. The SJC denied the complaint but went further, annulling Presbytery's recording of the Session…
